description: Get a working example to start from for a chart type: the reference's example, or the amCharts demo of that name. For a longer request it gives the closest example and says so. For a framework ('react', 'vue', 'angular', 'svelte') it gives how to use amCharts there.

chartType.description: Chart type, e.g. 'pie', 'line', 'stacked column', 'map', 'sankey', 'treemap', or a framework, e.g. 'react'

format.description: Output format: 'html' for script tags (cdn.amcharts.com, with the npm-CDN equivalent on jsDelivr/unpkg for pages that may load only from npm CDNs), 'esm' for ES module imports

name: get_quick_start
title: Get quick-start template
